description: Under the 2026-09-08 owner ruling eps := tr at z_D, level 2 is not multiplicative and so CAN see braid order. This enumerates every ordering of the two nucleon typed-crossing multisets (6930 + 9240) and reports the full reachable range of tr_{z_D}(Delta). The target is not inside it. Names no ordering; scope-(a).

data.markov_convention: D — the ruled functional, z_D = q^3/(q^2+1)

caveats: 🛑 LIVE FIT HAZARD, and it is the sharpest thing here. 'Order cannot manufacture agreement' is true against the EXPERIMENTAL WINDOW and badly misleading as a summary: some ordering reaches 0.0146 % of the target, against the canonical ordering's -15.45 %. Anyone exhibiting that ordering would be quoting a result an order of magnitude better than the retired published 0.17 %, and it would be PURE SELECTION — no continuous parameter tuned, an object chosen because it reproduces the measured value, which AGENTS.md NO FITTING names explicitly. What makes it refutable rather than unfalsifiable is only that it misses the 780 ppb window by 187x. This probe deliberately does not name it.
Scope-(a), and narrow: this enumerates ORDERINGS OF THE TWO EXISTING MULTISETS. It says nothing about other multisets, which is where Option E's remaining freedom lives.

Deliberately not a search: it reports a RANGE and names no ordering. Had the target been inside, that would have been a falsifiability problem rather than a solution — an ordering chosen because it lands on Q_beta is selection against the target, a fit under NO FITTING.

hm_num is a numeric transcription of the same Groebner-reduction tables as hm_sym; it is calibrated against the COMMITTED census values before the enumeration runs, so a mis-transcribed table fails CHECK 1 rather than producing a plausible wrong range.
